title: QC - Councils, Committees & Partnerships - 002 - Request to Join a Committee
description:
1. Frontend — Page Display & Form Submission (US-01)
User Story ID: QC-002 |
US-001 | REF: FR-028
User Story
As a public website visitor
representing a company,
I want to review information
about joining a Qatar Chamber committee and submit a Committee Joining Request
with my company and contact details,
So that Qatar Chamber's
Committee & Business Councils Department can review my application and
contact me directly regarding the next steps.
Preconditions
- The Qatar Chamber website is published and accessible.
- The Committee Joining Request page is published in the
CMS.
- The Sector/Committee, Established Since, Type of
Ownership and Size of Company, lookup lists are configured and published in the
CMS.
- The CAPTCHA service is available.
What the Visitor Sees
- Breadcrumb: Home › Councils, Committees &
Partnerships › Request to Join a Committee.
- Hero: the title “Request to Join a Committee” and the
description “Submit your company's details for review by Qatar Chamber's
Committee & Business Councils Department.”
- An informational section: eyebrow “Sectorial Councils,
Committees & Partnerships,” heading “Shape the Future of Your Sector,” and
explanatory paragraphs on what committees do and how to apply.
- A form card headed with an icon, the title “Committee
Joining Request,” and the disclaimer “Fields marked with * are required.
Submission confirms receipt for review; it does not confirm acceptance.”
- The form in three labelled groups:
Committee Selection (Select the
Sector / Committee*);
Company Information (Applicant
Name*, Company name*, CR Number*, Established Since*, Owner Name*, General
Manager / CEO*, Activity);
Contact & Classification
(Email*, Mobile Number*, Telephone (Direct Line), Fax, Website, Type of
Ownership*, Size of Company*, Number of Employees*).
- A CAPTCHA check, a consent line reading “By submitting
this form, you agree to our Privacy Policy, and confirm that the information
provided is accurate” with the Privacy Policy as a hyperlink, and a “Submit”
button.
Frontend Workflow
- Visitor navigates to Main Menu → Councils, Committees
& Partnerships → Request to Join a Committee.
- System displays the hero, the informational section,
and the Committee Joining Request form.
- Visitor selects the relevant Sector / Committee in the
Committee Selection group.
- Visitor completes the Company Information group
(Applicant Name, Company name, CR Number, Established Since, Owner Name,
General Manager / CEO, and the optional Activity field).
- Visitor completes the Contact & Classification
group, selecting Type of Ownership, Size of Company, and Number of Employees
from their respective dropdowns.
- Visitor completes the CAPTCHA and clicks “Submit.”
- System validates all mandatory fields and the CAPTCHA.
- On success, the system stores the submission with a
unique reference number and status “Pending,” and displays the bilingual
acknowledgement message.
- System sends the Submission Confirmation email to the
applicant and, separately, the New Request Notification email to the Qatar
Chamber team.
Acceptance Criteria
Given
the visitor opens the Request to Join a Committee page
When
the page renders
Then
the system shall display the hero, the informational section
(eyebrow, heading, and explanatory paragraphs), and the form card with its
title, disclaimer, and three field groups, bilingual EN/AR with correct
LTR/RTL.
Given
all mandatory fields and the CAPTCHA are valid
When
the visitor clicks “Submit”
Then
the system shall store the submission with a unique reference number
and status “Pending,” and display the bilingual acknowledgement message.
Given
a mandatory field is missing or invalid
When
the visitor completes or leaves a field
Then
the system shall apply real-time inline validation, display the
error against that field, and block submission until it is corrected.
Given
the visitor opens the Select the Sector / Committee dropdown
When
the dropdown renders
Then
the system shall display the 13 CMS-configured Sector/Committee
values (EN | AR) exactly as listed in the CMS Lookup Lists table.
Given
the CAPTCHA is not completed or fails verification
When
the visitor clicks “Submit”
Then
the system shall block submission and display a CAPTCHA error.
Given
a submission is successfully stored
When
the record is created
Then
the system shall send exactly two emails — the Submission
Confirmation to the applicant and the New Request Notification to the Qatar
Chamber team — and no others.
Given
the Sector/Committee, Established Since, Type of Ownership and Size
of Company lookups are maintained in the CMS
When
a value is added, renamed, or deactivated
Then
the corresponding form dropdown shall reflect the change
automatically, with no redevelopment required.
Given
the consent statement is displayed
When
the visitor clicks the Privacy Policy hyperlink
Then
the system shall open the configured Privacy Policy page.
Given
the page is opened on desktop, tablet, or mobile
When
it renders
Then
the layout shall be responsive.
Edge Cases
- "Please enter a valid email address." — يرجى إدخال بريد إلكتروني صحيح.
- "This field is required." — هذا
الحقل مطلوب.
- If the selected-language translation is missing, the
system falls back to the active language.
Negative Scenarios
- A submission missing any mandatory field shall not be
accepted.
- A submission without a completed, passing CAPTCHA shall
not be accepted.
- A draft/unpublished page shall not be visible to
visitors.
Post-condition
The Committee Joining Request is
stored with a unique reference number and status “Pending.” The applicant has received
the acknowledgement email and the Qatar Chamber team has been notified. Review
and any further communication take place per the Submission Review & Status
Workflow below.
Success Screen — On Form Submission (Visitor)
English: Your Committee
Joining Request has been submitted successfully. Your request is currently
under review. You will be contacted once the review is completed.
Arabic:
تم إرسال طلب الانضمام إلى
اللجنة بنجاح. طلبكم الآن قيد المراجعة. سيتم التواصل معكم بعد الانتهاء من
المراجعة.
2. Backend — Admin CMS Management: Page Content (US-02)
User Story ID: QC-002 |
US-002 | REF: FR-028
User Story
As a Site Content Editor,
I want to manage the Committee
Joining Request page content, the form's supporting text, and the form's lookup
lists,
So that the page stays accurate
and the form's dropdowns reflect Qatar Chamber's current committees, sectors,
and classifications.
Preconditions
- The admin holds the required role in the Liferay CMS
(RBAC).
- The Committee Joining Request page exists in the CMS
for both language versions.
Administrator Workflow
- Admin logs into the Liferay CMS and opens the Committee
Joining Request page.
- Updates the hero — page title, description, and
background image (EN/AR).
- Updates the informational section — eyebrow, heading,
and explanatory body content, including any hyperlinks (EN/AR).
- Updates the form card header — icon, form title,
disclaimer, consent statement, and the Privacy Policy link (EN/AR).
- Admin can create a Privacy Policy page and link it with
this form; clicking the consent statement's hyperlink opens that page and
displays its content or attached any PDF privacy file with hyperlink.
- Maintains the Sector/Committee, Established Since, Type
of Ownership and Size of Company lookup lists.
- Saves as draft, previews, then publishes where
permitted.
- System records all actions in the audit log and shows
the Liferay generic success toast (EN/AR).
Acceptance Criteria
Given
the admin manages the page content
When
the admin saves and publishes
Then
the system shall allow create, edit, preview, publish, and unpublish
for the page content where permitted.
Given
the admin updates the informational section body
When
the change is published
Then
the visitor-facing page shall reflect the change bilingually,
preserving paragraph formatting and any hyperlinks.
Given
the admin creates a Privacy Policy page and sets the Privacy Policy
link
When
the change is published
Then
the hyperlink in the consent statement shall resolve to that Privacy
Policy page.
Given
the admin adds, renames, or deactivates a lookup value
(Sector/Committee, Established Since, Type of Ownership, Size of Company)
When
the change is saved
Then
the corresponding form dropdown shall reflect it automatically, with
no redevelopment required.
Given
a lookup value has been used by existing submissions
When
the admin deactivates that value
Then
the value shall be removed from the form dropdown while remaining
intact on the historical submission records.
Given
any change is made
When
the admin acts
Then
the system shall display the Liferay generic toast message and
record the change in the audit log.
Negative Scenarios
- "Unsupported file type or size." — نوع الملف أو حجمه غير مدعوم.
- "Access Denied. You do not have permission to
perform this action." — تم رفض الوصول. ليس لديك صلاحية لتنفيذ هذا
الإجراء.
3. Backend — Submission Review & Status Workflow (US-03)
User Story ID: QC-003 |
US-003 | REF: FR-028
User Story
As a Form Manager,
I want to review submitted
Committee Joining Requests and approve or reject each request,
So that Qatar Chamber's
Committee & Business Councils Department can formally process committee
membership applications with a clear approval trail.
Preconditions
- The admin holds the Form Manager role in the Liferay
CMS.
- At least one submission exists.
Administrator Workflow
- Form Manager opens the Committee Joining Request
submissions listing.
- System displays the submitted records — reference
number, applicant name, company name, CR number, sector/committee, submission
date, and current status.
- Form Manager filters or searches by status,
sector/committee, company name, or date range.
- Form Manager opens a submission to review all captured
field values, read-only.
- Form Manager updates the request status: Pending
(default) → Approved or Rejected.
- If Rejected, the Form Manager must enter a rejection
reason before the status can be saved; the reason is stored internally with the
record.
- If Approved, the system automatically sends an Approval
email to the applicant; if Rejected, no email is sent to the applicant.
- System logs each status change with a timestamp and the
acting user, and shows the Liferay generic success toast.
Status Workflow
Status
Description
Email to Applicant
Pending
Submission received from
the visitor and awaiting review. Default status on submission.
Submission Confirmation
(sent at the point of submission, not at this stage)
Approved
Reviewed and accepted by
the Committee & Business Councils Department.
Approval Notification
Rejected
Reviewed and declined; a
rejection reason is mandatory and is stored internally with the record.
None
Acceptance Criteria
Given
a new submission is received
When
the record is created
Then
the system shall assign a unique reference number and set the status
to “Pending” by default.
Given
the Form Manager opens a submission
When
it loads
Then
all captured field values shall display read-only.
Given
a submission exists with status Pending
When
the Form Manager changes its status to Approved
Then
the system shall save the status change, record it with a timestamp
and the acting user, and send the Approval Notification email to the applicant.
Given
a submission exists with status Pending
When
the Form Manager attempts to change its status to Rejected without
entering a rejection reason
Then
the system shall block the status change and display a validation
error until a rejection reason is entered.
Given
a submission exists with status Pending
When
the Form Manager changes its status to Rejected with a rejection
reason entered
Then
the system shall save the status and the rejection reason internally
with the record, record the timestamp and acting user, and send no email to the
applicant.
Given
the Form Manager filters the listing
When
the filter is applied
Then
only submissions matching that filter shall display.
Given
any change is made to a submission
When
the Form Manager acts
Then
the change shall be audit-logged with a timestamp and the acting
user, and the Liferay generic toast shall display.
Negative Scenarios
- "A rejection reason is required before the status
can be saved." — يجب إدخال سبب الرفض قبل حفظ الحالة.
- The system shall not send any email as a result of a
Rejected status — the rejection reason is stored internally and never shared
with the applicant automatically.
- Status changes are manual and audit-logged; the system
shall not auto-progress or auto-reset a submission's status.
Post-condition
The submission's status is
updated and audit-logged. An Approved applicant receives the Approval
Notification email automatically; a Rejected applicant receives no email, and
the rejection reason is recorded internally against the request.

6. Permissions
Role
Capabilities
Site Content Editor
Manage the page content,
the informational section, the form header, disclaimer and consent statement,
and the Privacy Policy link; maintain the Sector/Committee, Established
Since, Type of Ownership, Size of Company, and Number of Employees lookup
lists; publish and unpublish the page.
Form Manager
View the submissions
listing, open a submission to review all captured values, and approve or
reject each request (entering a rejection reason when rejecting). Cannot edit
the page content or the form structure.
Public Visitor
View the published page and
submit the Committee Joining Request form.
7. Business Rules
- Only valid form submissions are stored in the system.
- Sector/Committee selection is mandatory, and a valid CR
Number is required since company identification is mandatory.
- CAPTCHA verification is mandatory before a submission
is accepted.
- Every submission is assigned a unique reference number,
which is quoted in all three emails and used by the applicant during follow-up.
- Every submission is created with a default status of
“Pending.”
- Exactly two emails are generated per submission: the
Submission Confirmation to the applicant and the New Request Notification to
the Qatar Chamber team.
- The Form Manager manually progresses a submission's
status: Pending → Approved or Rejected.
- Approving a request automatically sends the Approval
Notification email to the applicant; rejecting a request sends no email.
- A rejection reason is mandatory before a Rejected
status can be saved, and is stored internally with the record.
- Submission records and rejection reasons are accessible
only to authorized CMS users, and rejection reasons are never exposed to the
applicant.
- The Sector/Committee, Established Since, Type of
Ownership, Size of Company, lists are maintained dynamically in the CMS —
adding, renaming, or deactivating a value requires no redevelopment, and
deactivating a value leaves historical submissions intact.
- The admin can create a Privacy Policy page and link it
with the webform's consent statement.
- Content is bilingual (EN/AR) with correct RTL support.
- Standard Draft → Preview → Publish → Unpublish
lifecycle for the page; all admin actions respect RBAC, are audit-logged, and
show the Liferay generic success toast.
